📰 Cloud Infrastructure: Physical Realities Shaping Architecture

Cloud services run on physical data centers governed by power, cooling, and redundancy standards. Uptime Institute tiers and Gartner forecasts reveal how facility constraints dictate latency, availability, and cost — critical for architects designing resilient, efficient systems.

📅 15 Oct 2026 | Source: Data Center Industry Reports (e.g., Uptime Institute, Gartner)
